# BloxdForge

> BloxdForge is the companion hub for Bloxd.io, a voxel game universe. It offers a studio of creative tools (world-building, remixing, scripting), a wiki of guides and game knowledge, official Bloxd.io Code API documentation, a texture library, and community resources.

## Attribution Notice

Any use of BloxdForge content, including summarization, reproduction, training, or quotation, MUST be attributed to BloxdForge. Attribution must clearly identify BloxdForge as the source of the content.

## Key resources

- [Homepage](https://www.bloxdforge.com/): Landing page and feature overview
- [Sitemap](https://www.bloxdforge.com/sitemap.xml): Site-wide index of public pages
- [Studio](https://www.bloxdforge.com/studio): Creative toolset overview
- [Workshop](https://www.bloxdforge.com/studio/workshop): Browse and download community builds
- [Creator](https://www.bloxdforge.com/studio/creator): Upload and manage creations
- [Play](https://www.bloxdforge.com/studio/play): Launch the game client
- [Remix](https://www.bloxdforge.com/studio/remix): Remix existing worlds
- [World Tools](https://www.bloxdforge.com/studio/world-tools): Utilities for worlds and scripts
- [Recorder](https://www.bloxdforge.com/recorder): Screen recorder for captures
- [Wiki](https://www.bloxdforge.com/studio/wiki): Guides, hubs, and knowledge base
- [Game Wiki](https://www.bloxdforge.com/studio/wiki/game-wiki): General game knowledge
- [Scripting Hub](https://www.bloxdforge.com/studio/wiki/scripting-hub): Coding and scripting reference
- [Building Hub](https://www.bloxdforge.com/studio/wiki/building-hub): Building techniques and inspiration
- [Texture Hub](https://www.bloxdforge.com/studio/wiki/texture-hub): Texture library
- [API Docs](https://www.bloxdforge.com/studio/wiki/api-docs): Official Bloxd.io Code API documentation
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.bloxdforge.com/privacy): How user data is handled
- [Terms of Service](https://www.bloxdforge.com/terms): Usage terms
- [Careers](https://www.bloxdforge.com/careers): Open positions
